title: Rock and metal: synthesized guitar tiers, bass guitar, rock / metal kits, riff grammar, song form, five feels
doc: Pack glyphcore/rockmetal (CC0-1.0, docs/CONVENTIONS.md section 13, sources docs/ROCKMETAL_REFERENCES.md). E minor throughout (E2 = 82 Hz power chords, E1 bass), one cycle = one bar of 4/4 on 16 steps. Guitars are native plucked-string approximations with amp tiers; only gtrHigh and chugHigh use one distort stage.

section.title: Rock and metal: guitars, bass, kits, riffs, forms, feels
section.explain: Pack glyphcore/rockmetal (docs/CONVENTIONS.md 13; sources docs/ROCKMETAL_REFERENCES.md). E minor. Guitar-like voices (class guitar, 70-8000 Hz): gtrClean, gtrCrunch, palmMute (native), gtrHigh, chugHigh (one distort stage, cab low-pass before it); gtrLead, gtrHarmonic, feedbackSwell; bass guitar bassFinger, bassPick; kits rockKick, metalKick, rockSnare, rockHat, rockRide, crashCym, rockTom; organ, rockStrings, vowelVox (no words). Atoms rm.: rock / shuffle / half-time / double-kick / blast / thrash / doom drum patterns, fills, power chords pI .. pbVII, riff cells riffA / riffB / riff (A A A B), chug, gallop, breakdown (3+3+4+2+4), phrygian and doom riffs, bass lines, lead, chords, a 72-bar song form as gates. Five feels: feel-rock, feel-shuffle, feel-rockhalftime, feel-thrash, feel-doom.

racksDoc: Chain-only hook defs of glyphcore/rockmetal: guitar tiers (clean, crunch, high gain), palm mutes and chugs, lead, harmonics, feedback, bass guitar, rock / metal drums, organ, strings, vowel voice; every rack starts with its hygiene rack (class guitar is new: docs/RACK_STANDARD.md section 10).

atomsIngredient.title: Rock and metal atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/rockmetal atoms (rm.): drum patterns (rock, shuffle, half-time, double kick, blast, thrash, doom), fills, power chords, riff cells and grammar (A A A B), chug, gallop, breakdown, bass and lead lines, chords, the 72-bar song form as gates. Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/rockmetal:atoms-rockmetal").

labels: guitar band, riff, backbeat, power chords
heavy, high gain, double kick, chug, riff
plucked string, amp, power chord, palm mute

gtrClean.doc: clean guitar: saw + triangle, low-pass 3 kHz with a 2-octave envelope falling in 300 ms (the string losing its highs), 800 ms decay to 20 %, small room; a plucked-string approximation with native voices (superdough has no Karplus-Strong voice)

gtrCrunch.doc: crunch tier (native): saw + square with low-index FM at ratio 2 (even-harmonic grit, no worklet), a 2 kHz resonant amp-mid hump, high-pass 90 Hz

gtrHigh.doc: high-gain tier: saw + square into one distort stage (the only worklet stage of the pack, RACK_STANDARD 9), cab low-pass 3.2 kHz (24 dB, pre-drive: superdough order), tight high-pass 100 Hz

palmMute.doc: palm-muted chug (native): crunch voice with a 90 ms decay and a dark 900 Hz low-pass with a fast envelope: the muted string thump

chugHigh.doc: high-gain chug: the palm mute through one distort stage, 100 ms

gtrLead.doc: lead guitar: saw, resonant 4 kHz low-pass, dotted-8th delay and room; add vibrato on the lane (.vib(5.5).vibmod(0.25)): in the rack it smeared the harmonics past the alias test window

gtrHarmonic.doc: natural harmonic: sine with a long ring (1.2 s), the glassy 12th / 19th-fret overtone

feedbackSwell.doc: feedback swell: sine fading in over 1.5 s with a slow vibrato, held

bassFinger.doc: finger bass: triangle, 1.2 kHz low-pass with a short envelope, 4 ms attack, round

bassPick.doc: pick bass: saw, brighter 1.8 kHz low-pass with a 2-octave snap in 80 ms, 2 ms attack

rockKick.doc: rock kick: sine 55 Hz with a 20-semitone knock in 40 ms, 350 ms

metalKick.doc: metal kick: tight and clicky for double-kick 16ths: sine 60 Hz, 24-semitone knock in 20 ms, 150 ms

rockSnare.doc: rock snare: triangle on D3 + white noise, 250 ms, a room

rockTom.doc: tom: pitched sine with an 8-semitone knock, 400 ms; pitch from the pattern (fills run high to low)

organ.doc: drawbar-style organ: sine + square, a slight 6 Hz vibrato (a slow rotary), sustained

rockStrings.doc: string pad: saw, 0.4 s attack, 2.5 kHz low-pass, 180 Hz high-pass (the guitars own the low mids)

vowelVox.doc: voice as instrument (no words): saw through a / o formants with a 5 Hz vibrato

kick.doc: straight rock kick: 1, 3 and the and of 3

shuffleHats.doc: shuffle hats: triplet 8ths, the middle one left out

shuffleKick.doc: shuffle kick on the triplet grid

halfKick.doc: half-time kick: 1 and the a of 2

blastKick.doc: blast beat kick: every 8th (kick and snare alternate 16ths)

blastSnare.doc: blast beat snare: the 16ths between the kicks

thrashKick.doc: thrash skank beat kick on the beats

thrashSnare.doc: thrash skank beat snare on the offbeat 8ths

doomKick.doc: doom kick: once a bar, let it ring

tomFill.doc: tom fill on beats 3-4, high to low

snareFill.body: ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x x x x [x x] [x x] [x x] [x x]
snareFill.doc: snare fill: 16ths then 32nds into the next bar

riffA.doc: riff cell A: I on the 1 and the and of 2, bIII and IV pushed (anticipating the next beat)

riffB.doc: riff cell B: same start, the turnaround falls bVII bVI (the answer)

riff.doc: 4-bar riff: A A A B (call, call, call, answer)

chug.doc: chug cell on the open low string, rests as part of the rhythm

gallop.doc: gallop: an 8th and two 16ths per beat

breakdown.doc: breakdown grammar: 3+3+4+2+4 sixteenths, on palm mute with the kick locked to it

breakdownKick.doc: breakdown kick in unison with the chug

phryg.doc: single-note phrygian riff cell: the half step E-F is the menace

doomRiff.doc: doom riff: one chord per 2 beats, held

bassRoot.doc: bass guitar on the roots, locked to the kick

lead.doc: lead phrase (own): climbs to the root, falls back through the 7th and 6th

chords.doc: Em C D Bm, one bar each (organ / strings)

intro.doc: intro: bars 1-4 (form: intro 4, verse 8, pre 4, chorus 8, verse 8, pre 4, chorus 8, bridge / breakdown 8, solo 8, chorus 8, outro 4 = 72 bars)

fills.doc: the bar before each section change into or out of a chorus: fills

crashBars.doc: the first bar of each chorus / the breakdown: crash

recipes.intent: Kick on 1, 3 and the and of 3, snare on 2 and 4, accented 8th hats, a.

recipes.title: Double kick under half-time
recipes.intent: 16th double kick with accented downstrokes under a half-time snare.

recipes.title: Blast beat and thrash skank
recipes.intent: A bar of blast beat (kick and snare alternating 16ths) then a bar of.

recipes.title: Tom and snare fills
recipes.intent: A tom fill high to low on beats 3-4, then a snare fill of 16ths into.

recipes.title: Organ and strings
recipes.intent: Em C D Bm on a drawbar-style organ and a string pad high-passed above.

recipes.title: Metal breakdown grammar
recipes.intent: 3+3+4+2+4 chug with the kick in unison, a half-time snare and a crash.

recipes.title: Riff grammar: A A A B
recipes.intent: A 4-bar riff built from two cells (call three times, answer once).

recipes.title: Doom riff
recipes.intent: One chord per two beats, held; bass held under it; kick once a bar.

syntax.title: Pick a rock / metal feel (one import line)
syntax.code:
setcpm(120/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/rockmetal:feel-rock", { as: "feel" })   // or feel-shuffle, feel-rockhalftime, feel-thrash, feel-doom
hooks.bind("kick", atoms.feel.kickRack)
hooks.bind("snare", atoms.feel.snareRack)
hooks.bind("perc", atoms.feel.percRack)
hooks.bind("hats", atoms.feel.hatsRack)
hooks.bind("top", atoms.feel.topRack)
hooks.bind("bass", atoms.feel.bassRack)
hooks.bind("harmony", atoms.feel.harmonyRack)
hooks.bind("fx", atoms.feel.fxRack)
kick: s(atoms.feel.kick).velocity(atoms.feel.kickVel).use("kick", { mode: "swap" })
snare: s(atoms.feel.snare).velocity(atoms.feel.snareVel).use("snare", { mode: "swap" })
perc: s(atoms.feel.perc).velocity(atoms.feel.percVel).use("perc", { mode: "swap" })
hats: s(atoms.feel.hats).velocity(atoms.feel.hatsVel).use("hats", { mode: "swap" })
top: note(atoms.feel.top).velocity(atoms.feel.topVel).use("top", { mode: "swap" })
bass: note(atoms.feel.bass).velocity(atoms.feel.bassVel).use("bass", { mode: "swap" })
harmony: note(atoms.feel.harmony).velocity(atoms.feel.harmonyVel).use("harmony", { mode: "swap" })
fx: s(atoms.feel.fx).velocity(atoms.feel.fxVel).use("fx", { mode: "swap" })

syntax.title: Song form as gates (verse, chorus, bridge, solo)
syntax.code:
setcpm(120/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/rockmetal:atoms-rockmetal")
hooks.bind("gtr", "gtrClean"); hooks.bind("gtr", "gtrCrunch", atoms.rm.choruses)   // the chorus switches amp tier
kick: s(atoms.rm.kick).hook("rockKick").tags("drums")
snare: s(atoms.rm.snare).hook("rockSnare").tags("drums")
fill: s(atoms.rm.snareFill).hook("rockSnare").mask("<0!15 1 0!4>")
crash: s(atoms.rm.crashOne).hook("crashCym").mask("<0!16 1 0!3>")
gtr: note(atoms.rm.riff).use("gtr")
bass: note(atoms.rm.bassRoot).hook("bassPick")
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.rm.intro)

syntax.title: Riff grammar: cells, answer, displacement
syntax.code:
setcpm(120/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/rockmetal:atoms-rockmetal")
// A A A B: call three times, answer once; the chug displaced by a 16th in bar 4 (.late) for tension
call: note(atoms.rm.riffA).hook("gtrCrunch").mask("<1 1 1 0>")
answer: note(atoms.rm.riffB).hook("gtrCrunch").mask("<0 0 0 1>")
chug: note(atoms.rm.chug).hook("palmMute").late("<0 0 0 0.0625>")
kick: s(atoms.rm.kick).hook("rockKick")
snare: s(atoms.rm.snare).hook("rockSnare")

syntax.title: Metal breakdown: chug and kick in unison
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/rockmetal:atoms-rockmetal")
chug: note(atoms.rm.breakdown).hook("chugHigh")
kick: s(atoms.rm.breakdownKick).hook("metalKick")
snare: s(atoms.rm.halfSnare).hook("rockSnare")
crash: s(atoms.rm.crashOne).hook("crashCym").mask("<1 0>")
